o.en: Show the supported python3 versions. List is lowest version to highest version with the default version last (e.g. python3.4 python3.6 python3.5 if python3.4, 3.5, and 3.6 are supported, but python3.5 is the default python3).

Reads the value of the X-Python3-Version field in the source section of a control file and shows all matching python3 versions. The parameter is interpreted as a version string, if it is not the name of a file.
Show the installed supported python3 versions.
Show the minimum supported python3 version.
Show the maximum supported python3 version.
Limit the output to the version numbers of the python3 versions.
